summary: Resolve path segments right-to-left to an absolute Node path, consulting the process cwd only when needed.

requirements.path_flavor: default host, posix, or win32 is statically known

target.notes: The helper must share cwd state with process.cwd()/process.chdir(); a compiler-time working directory is not equivalent.

semantics.direction: segments processed right-to-left until an absolute path is formed
semantics.cwd: used only when no absolute segment resolves the path

caveats: Windows drive-relative paths such as C:foo depend on per-drive cwd semantics and require the win32-compatible helper.

tests.name: edge later absolute resets prior segments
